harf-e-zaid.title: حرف زائد
harf-e-zaid.caption: Quran mein ek bhi harf zaid (redundant letter) nahi, ek tafseeli guftagu
harf-e-zaid.description: Baat ek aise muaahide se shuru hoti hai jis ki ek shiq 'nahin' kehti hai aur wakeel use itminaan se 'main qasam khata hoon' parh leta hai: aisa faltu lafz jo koi qanooni dastawez mein bhi qabool na kare, kalam-e-ilahi mein to kya. Yahi harf-e-zaid hai, aur nahviyon ki is aadat ke muqabil ke kisi harf ko zaid keh diya jaye, Hazrat Mahdi ahs ka farman hai ke Quran mein ek bhi harf zaid nahin. Mughni al-Labib ki roshni mein ek hi 'min' ke chaar kaam saamne aate hain: jins batana, hissa lena, bayan karna aur sabab dena; shehr ki qasam se pehle 'la' munkireen ke us inkaar ka jawab nikalta hai jo abhi zaban par bhi nahin aaya tha; ek surah mein deewangi ke taane ka jawab doosri surah mein milta hai, kyunke poora Quran ek hi surah hai; baad ke ek ustaad un do bade nahviyon ki tardeed karte hain jinhon ne ek doosre 'la' ko zaid kaha tha; aur 'laata' 'la' ke saath jura hua koi harf nahin balke ek mukammal fe'l nikalta hai. Aakhir mein sawal ye ke kya hum apne aas paas ke logon ki hichkichahat ko bhi bharti ke alfaz samajh kar nazarandaz kar dete hain, aur aisa kar ke kya kho dete hain.

thumbnail.title: Quran ka *har lafz ba-mani* hai. Ek laraib kalaam e ilahi hai.

harf-e-zaid.title: حرف زائد
harf-e-zaid.caption: Kya Quran mein koi harf-e-zaid (redundant letter) hai?
harf-e-zaid.description: Harf-e-zaid ka mukhtasar jaiza: kya Quran jaisi kaamil kitab mein bhi woh bharti ke alfaz ho sakte hain jin par hamari apni tehreer tikti hai? Mughni al-Labib aur Hazrat Mahdi ahs ke faramin ki roshni mein Surah Fatir ka 'min' ek dheela jor nahin balke us rehmat ki qisam par ek roshni nikalta hai jis ka zikr hai; Surah al-Balad mein qasam se pehle 'la' munkireen ke daawon ki woh nafi hai jo qasam se pehle hi kar di gayi, kyunke poora Quran ek hi surah ki tarah jura hua hai; aur 'laata' ek mukammal fe'l-e-maazi hai jis mein koi harf faltu nahin. Aakhir mein sawal ye ke rozmarra ki tilawat mein hum kitne poshida khazanon ke qareeb se guzar jaate hain.

thumbnail.title: Kya Quran mein koi *harf zaid* hai?

hazf.title: حذف
hazf.caption: Hazf par ek mukhtasar izhar-e-khayal
hazf.description: Hazf ka khulasa: riwayati mufassireen kehte hain ke Quran mein kai jagah alfaz mehzoof hain, magar Hazrat Mahdi ahs ke mutabiq koi lafz ghaib nahin, woh siyaq-o-sabaq mein muqaddar hota hai, jaise bus stand par driver sirf 'Madina, Madina' pukare to jumla ghaib nahin hota, sunne wala niyat samajh jata hai. Phir ye sawal ke jo maahireen Quran ke baad khud grammar ke usool banayen aur phir unhi par Quran mein khaami nikalen, ye kaisi baat hai. Do misalein: 'Rabb-ighfir li' mein mufassireen ke mutabiq 'mera' mehzoof hai, magar 'rabb' ke neeche ki zer khud us ka pata de rahi hai; aur Hazrat Musa as ke asa maarne ke foran baad chashmon ka phootna hi asa maarne ko zahir kar deta hai. Khulasa ye ke Quran mein koi lafz ghaib nahin, balke kalam ke andar poshida hai, jise Allah ka sacha aur masoom khalifa hi samjha sakta hai.

hazf.title: حذف
hazf.caption: Hazf ka khulasa: Quran mein hazf nahi, ek tafseeli guftagu
hazf.description: Baat ek aise paighaam se shuru hoti hai jis mein sirf 'ghar pohnch gaya' likha ho aur parhne wala poori baat samajh le, aur yahin se hazf ki taraf aati hai: mufassireen ka ye nazariya ke Quran mein kai jagah alfaz mehzoof hain, jin ki ek nahvi ne chhiyalees qismein ginwayi hain. Is ke muqabil Hazrat Mahdi ahs ka farman hai ke Quran mein hazf nahin: jo lafz siyaq-o-sabaq khud de raha ho woh muqaddar hai, sunne wale ke zehn mein maujood, aur manwi, kehne wale ki niyat mein shamil, ghaib nahin. Sawal ye ke nuzool ke sadiyon baad murattab hone wale balaghat ke usool us par hukm kaise lagane lage, jaise koi darzi coat ke mutabiq gahak ko kaat de, aur itnab, yani lambi baat, ijaz ke muqabil rakha jaata hai, woh ikhtisar jo Arabi fasahat ki meraj hai. Phir teen aayaat: Surah al-Hadid mein 'barabar nahin' khud doosre fareeq ka taqaza karta hai, jise agli satar naam deti hai; Surah al-Baqarah mein pathar se phootte chashme bata dete hain ke Hazrat Musa as ne asa maara, bagair asa maarne ke lafz ke, jaise chaabi ghumate hi engine jawab de; aur Surah al-Hajj mein 'ye dilon ka taqwa hai' do lafz barhate hi apni quwwat kho deta hai. Aakhir mein sawal ye ke kya hum bhi us cheez ko ghalat parh lete hain jo hamare apne banaye saanchon mein nahin samaati.

istisna-munqati.title: استثناء منقطع
istisna-munqati.caption: Kya Quran mein istisna munqati (disjoined exception) hai?
istisna-munqati.description: Istisna munqati ka khulasa. Pehle istisna ki do qismein: muttasil, jahan alag ki gayi cheez usi giroh ka hissa ho, jaise 'sab aaye siwaye Zaid ke', aur munqati, jo be-jor lage, jaise 'sab aaye siwaye gadhe ke'. Hazrat Mahdi ahs ne wazeh kiya ke kalam-e-ilahi mein koi be-jor baat nahin ho sakti, is liye Quran ka har istisna muttasil hai. Phir do aayaat: Surah Yunus mein kisi basti ka imaan us ke kaam na aaya 'siwaye Hazrat Yunus as ki qaum ke', jise baaz ne be-jor kaha kyunke qaum aur basti alag lagte hain, magar yahan basti se murad basti ke log hi hain; aur Surah al-Baqarah mein 'woh kitab nahin jaante siwaye amani ke', jahan amani ka matlab bina samjhe tilawat karna liya jaye to poori aayat jur jaati hai. Khulasa ye ke jo aayaat bazahir be-jor lagti hain woh Hazrat Mahdi ahs ke bataye usoolon par parakhne se kaamil aur gehre maani ke saath jur jaati hain.

istisna-munqati.title: استثناء منقطع
istisna-munqati.caption: Istisna munqati aur Istisna muttasil ke tafseelat aur uski haqeeqat
istisna-munqati.description: Istisna munqati ka tafseeli jaiza, woh istisna jo bazahir pichhli baat se kat jaata hai. Shuruat istisna ki do qismon se, phir Hazrat Mahdi ahs ke is mauqif ke saath ke Quran mein koi istisna munqati nahin, baat un do aayaat tak pohnchti hai jin par nahviyon ne haar maan li thi: Surah Yunus mein basti aur Hazrat Yunus as ki qaum kaise ek hi nikalte hain, aur Surah al-Baqarah mein amani ka matlab tamannaon ke bajaye tilawat ya gharhi hui baatein kaise banta hai. Aakhir mein ye ke yeh usool sirf kitabon hi nahin, logon ko parhne wale se bhi kya maangta hai.

jumla-e-mustanifa.title: جملہ مستأنفہ
jumla-e-mustanifa.caption: Jumla-e-mustanifa (resumptive clause) ka mukhtasar jaiza
jumla-e-mustanifa.description: Ek aisi kitab ka tasawwur jo rawani se chal rahi ho aur beech mein achanak ek aisa jumla aa jaye jis ka pichhli baat se koi talluq na ho, jaise chhapai ki ghalti ho. Yahi jumla-e-mustanifa hai, apne se pehle kalam se kata hua jumla, jise aam mufassireen ne Quran mein maan liya. Magar agar koi jumla siyaq-o-sabaq se kata hua maan liya jaye to kya ye khaami nahin ban jaati? Hazrat Mahdi ahs ka mauqif hai ke kalam-e-ilahi mein aisa koi jumla ho hi nahin sakta, har lafz aur har jumla ek mukammal tarteeb mein jura hua hai. Phir ye ke tarjuma parhne walon ko mauzu badalte kyun lagte hain: mutashabihat, aur Surah Aal-e-Imran ke 'ar-rasikhoona fil ilm', jin ke baare mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas rz aur Hazrat Mujahid rh ki riwayaat batati hain ke Allah koi aisi cheez nazil nahin karta jis ka matlab kisi ko maloom na ho. Aur Surah al-A'raf ke A'raf walon ki jannat ki umeed, jo naya jumla nahin balke un ki sifat hai, un ki maujooda haalat ko un ki aakhri manzil se jorti hui. Aakhir mein sawal ye ke agar kalam-e-ilahi ke har jumle mein aisa kaamil rabt hai to kya kainaat ke bazahir bikhre waqiaat ke peeche bhi aisa hi tasalsul nahin hoga.

jumla-e-mustanifa.title: جملہ مستأنفہ
jumla-e-mustanifa.caption: Quran ek marboot kalam hai, koi ayat Jumla-e-mustanifa nahi
jumla-e-mustanifa.description: Kya grammar ka ek chhota sa nukta, ke jumla apne se pehle wale se jurta hai ya kat jaata hai, kisi ilhaami kitab ka matlab badal sakta hai? Jumla-e-mustanifa ek aisi rail gaari ki tarah hai jis ka jor khol diya gaya ho, aur nuzool ke baad likhe gaye usool lagane wale mufassireen ne jahan jor na mila wahan naya jumla qarar de diya. Is ke muqabil Hazrat Mahdi ahs ka mauqif hai ke Quran mein aisa koi jumla hai hi nahin. Ye mauqif do aayaat par parkha jaata hai: Surah Aal-e-Imran mein ilm mein pukhta log ta'wil ke ilm mein Allah ke saath shareek hain, naya jumla shuru nahin karte, jis par Hazrat Mujahid rh aur Hazrat Ibn Abbas rz gawah hain aur ilm ka silsila Nabi Kareem slm se chala aata hai; aur Surah al-A'raf mein A'raf par khare log jo abhi jannat mein daakhil nahin hue, usi jumle se bayan ho rahe hain, us se kate hue nahin. Aakhir mein sawal ye ke grammar ke parde ke peeche aise aur kitne raaz chhupe hain.

jumla-e-mutarida.title: جملۂ معترضہ
jumla-e-mutarida.caption: Jumla-e-mutarida ki tafseelat: Ek fiqhi aur mantiqi behes
jumla-e-mutarida.description: Baat kainaat ke source code se shuru hoti hai, jahan koi bracket faltu nahin, aur yahi tasawwur jumla-e-mutarida tak le jaata hai, woh jumla jise nahvi baat ke beech mein aayi hui ek alag si baat samajhte hain. Hazrat Mahdi ahs ka mauqif hai ke Quran mein aisa koi jumla nahin, aur ye un teen aayaat par parkha jaata hai jin ko mufassireen ne bracket mein rakh diya tha: Surah al-Baqarah mein ye ke munkireen ko darane na darane se farq nahin parta, do khabron mein se pehli khabar hai, koi zimni baat nahin; aage Bani Israel ka insha Allah apni jaza ke saath ek shart hai, mehz ek dua nahin; aur Surah al-A'raf mein ye waada ke kisi jaan par us ki taaqat se barh kar bojh nahin, khud khabar hai, halat-e-raf' mein. Aakhir mein sawal ye ke kya zindagi ke bazahir bikhre hue lamhe bhi mutarida hain.

jumla-e-mutarida.title: جملۂ معترضہ
jumla-e-mutarida.caption: Jumla-e-mutarida (parenthetical clause) ka mukhtasar jaiza
jumla-e-mutarida.description: Jumla-e-mutarida ka mukhtasar jaiza: baat ke beech mein aaya hua jumla, jaise kisi faqeeh ke naqal kiye hue qaul mein 'Allah un par rehm farmaye' ki dua, jise nikaal bhi diya jaye to asal masla jyun ka tyun rehta hai. Aam mufassireen ne Quran mein aise jumle maan liye; Hazrat Mahdi ahs ka mauqif hai ke us mein aisa koi jumla nahin, har satar kisi imaarat ke naqshe ki lakeer ki tarah bojh uthaye hue hai. Teen aayaat daleel hain: Surah al-Baqarah mein 'un ke liye barabar hai, tum unhen darao ya na darao' pehli khabar hai, koi zimni baat nahin; Bani Israel ka insha Allah aage ki baat par ek shart hai, mehz dua nahin; aur Surah al-A'raf mein 'hum kisi jaan par us ki taaqat se barh kar bojh nahin daalte' pichhli baat ki daleel hai. Aakhir mein sawal ye ke kya hamari rozmarra ki baaton mein bhi aise rabt hote hain jinhen hum aadatan nazarandaz kar dete hain.

naskh.title: نسخ
naskh.caption: Kya Quran mein Naskh (abrogation) hai?
naskh.description: Mahdavia aqeede mein Quran ke andar naskh ka tasawwur kyun radd kiya jaata hai, teen baaton mein. Pehli: Hazrat Mahdi ahs ka wazeh farman ke maujooda Quran ki koi bhi parhi jaane wali aayat mansookh nahin; agar Allah Aleem-o-Hakeem hai to kisi aayat ko mehz tilawat ke liye kyun baaqi rakhe ga jis par amal na karna ho. Doosri: Shah Waliullah Dehlavi ne sainkron mansookh kahi jaane wali aayaat ko ghata kar paanch tak mehdood kiya tha, magar Mahdavi nuqta-e-nazar un paanch mein bhi naskh nahin maanta; woh aayaat mansookh nahin balke makhsoos haalaat ke lihaz se di gayi narmi ya riayat hain. Teesri: is nazariye ke tehet poora Quran aam qari ke liye wazeh hai, jaisa insaan ka haal hoga waisa hi hukm laagu hoga, jaise first aid kit mein koi dawa bekaar nahin hoti, bas dekhna hota hai ke maujooda haalat mein kaun si istemaal karni hai.

thumbnail.title: *Naskh* ke radd mein, ye teen nukaat samajhte hain

naskh.title: نسخ
naskh.caption: Naasikh o Mansookh par tafseeli guftagu: usul-e-figh aur tafseer ka jaiza
naskh.description: Baat ek aise phone se shuru hoti hai jis ke update ke baare mein kaha jaye ke us ne aadhe features bekaar kar diye, jab tak software banane wala ye na bataye ke kuch hataya nahin gaya, har feature ka apna mauqa hai. Yahi naskh hai: Shah Waliullah Dehlavi ki al-Fawz al-Kabir mein darj hai ke kabhi paanch sau aayaat mansookh maani jaati theen, jinhen unhon ne ghata kar paanch kiya, aur un paanch ke muqabil bhi Hazrat Mahdi ahs ka farman hai ke Quran ki koi aayat mansookh nahin. Har ek parkhi jaati hai: Surah al-Baqarah ki wasiyat ki aayat, jo un rishtedaron ke liye jagah bharti hai jo waaris nahin ban sakte; Surah al-Anfal ke bees muqabil do sau, jise riayat ke taur par sau kiya gaya jabke meyaar qaim raha; Surah al-Ahzab ki azwaj wali aayaat, jahan nasikh kahi jaane wali aayat pehle utri aur sirf ek hadd kheenchti hai; Surah al-Mujadila mein khalwat se pehle sadqa, ek aisi chhanni jis par sirf Hazrat Ali rz ne amal kiya aur jis ki rooh zakat mein zinda hai; aur Surah al-Muzzammil ki raat ki ibadat, jo sirf Nabi Kareem slm par laazim thi aur un sahaba rz ke liye aasaan ki gayi jo un ke saath is mein shareek hue. Aakhir mein sawal ye ke hum ne apni sahulat ke liye kaun se ahkaam chup chaap khud hi mansookh kar liye hain.
